jobs.title: Senior, Stores Product Management
jobs.description:
Be part of an amazing story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

The Senior, Product Manager brings a high-energy approach to developing customer-centric user experiences and features to help grow the customer base, drive user engagement, and improve overall site experience on the fast-moving e-commerce team. This role operates as a hybrid between strategy and execution. They partner with stakeholders to define, own, and execute a product roadmap while mentoring more junior colleagues on a range of product skills.

Working in an agile environment with a focus on continuous improvement, they encourage ideas and feedback. They are empowered to make decisions and contribute in a meaningful and impactful way, fostering customer-centric thinking to create memorable, loyalty-building experiences for every Macy's customer and new possibilities for their career.

What You Will Do

- Take ownership of the entire product roadmap, from its definition to execution, including establishing and maintaining partnerships with stakeholders to ensure alignment

- Assume responsibility for managing a complex product area or lead as the senior product manager, driving the work forward

- Collaborate with partners and pods to effectively coordinate cross-functional projects and objectives, with support from senior leaders

- Lead discussions and decision-making processes in large working team settings, guiding the agenda

- Structure and prioritize analyses to inform the roadmap, including effectively setting up A/B tests

- Maintain a well-curated backlog of user stories driven by insights gleaned from structured discovery, which directly impacts the product roadmap

- Contribute meaningfully to technical requirements alongside QE and engineering

- Translate business needs into technical requirements for engineers to align with business goals, providing clear, detailed, and timely artifacts

- Offer timely and constructive feedback to team members, leaders, and cross-functional partners, challenging when necessary

- Actively mentor junior colleagues on various product skills

- Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities

Skills You Will Need

Leadership : Ability to take ownership of the entire product roadmap, manage complex product areas, and lead cross-functional teams effectively

Collaboration and Communication : Skilled at collaborating with partners, stakeholders, and senior leaders, with strong communication abilities to deliver presentations, influence decisions, and answer questions

Agility and Adaptability : Thrives in a high-energy, fast-paced, outcome-oriented environment, with the ability to adapt to changing priorities and situations

Analytical Skills : Proficient in structuring and prioritizing analyses to inform the product roadmap, utilizing data and analytics to make informed decisions

Customer-Centricity : Customer obsessed with a deep understanding of retail commerce and user experience, distinguishing between store and ecommerce business drivers to create memorable experiences

Technical Acumen : Understanding of technical concepts, enabling meaningful contributions to technical requirements alongside engineering teams

Problem-Solving and Curiosity : Naturally curious with a strong desire to understand root causes and solve problems, continuously learning about industry trends, emerging technologies, and new methodologies

Mentorship and Coaching : Willingness to mentor and coach junior colleagues, sharing knowledge freely and helping to develop their skills

Organizational Skills : Strong attention-to-detail, effective time management, and organizational abilities to maintain a well-curated backlog and prioritize tasks effectively

Software Proficiency : Skilled in Microsoft Office Suite and other relevant software tools for product management and analysis.

Who You Are

- Candidates with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply.

- 6+ years of overall work experience with at least 4 years specific product management experience, preferably within an agile framework; experience operating in a retail environment is a plus.

- Regularly required to sit, talk, hear; use hands/fingers to touch, handle, and feel

- Occasionally required to move about the workplace and reach with hands and arms

- Requires close vision

- Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

- Merchandise discounts

- Performance-based incentives

- Annual merit review

- Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

- Tuition reimbursement

Access the full menu of benefits offerings  here .

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

jobs.title: Product Analyst
jobs.description:
Be part of an amazing story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

The Product Analyst is a member of the Analytics Team which empowers macys.com with analytic insights to support planning, tactical execution, and optimizing the customer experience. They support Product Management, User Experience, & Technology teams with reporting and analysis, delivering crucial business intelligence. The analyst presents actionable insights to aid decision-makers and assists Macys.com’s A/B and multivariate testing programs. This involves designing and analyzing experiments in collaboration with internal clients like Marketing and Merchandising, as well as technology partners. The role requires multitasking through various project stages and delivering quality insights and recommendations regularly to drive business growth. Other duties as assigned.

What You Will Do

- Support Product Management, User Experience, & Technology teams in identifying opportunities to enhance site functionality and increase site monetization.

- Develop measurement plans and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to assess the success of new enhancements and experiments on the site.

- Collaborate with Marketing and Customer Insights to provide a customer-centric perspective to web and mobile app project analysis and insights.

- Design experiments, validate test data, conduct analysis, and report results to measure the impact of functionality enhancements on site metrics such as traffic and conversion.

- Communicate test results, insights, and actionable recommendations effectively.

- Provide retrospective analysis on projects, collaborate with Product Management and Finance to provide metrics input, and assist in quantifying sales drivers from technology enhancements.

- Collaborate with Marketing Systems to identify reporting requirements for new site functionality and assist in creating specifications for technology teams to implement correct analytics code.

- Utilize analytics tools to address business inquiries and present findings to key decision-makers.

- Produce ad hoc analysis as requested by internal customer teams.

- Develop and publish reports and dashboards for internal customers.

- Demonstrate full understanding and application of digital analytics tools to achieve business objectives.

- Partner with technology teams to utilize in-house and third-party analytic tools effectively.

- Assist in managing and documenting web analytics projects.

- Support and train internal users on digital analytics tools.

- Stay updated on trends and best practices in digital analytics and e-commerce.

- Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities

- Maintain regular, dependable attendance and punctuality.

Skills You Will Need

Analytical Skills : Proficiency in analyzing data and drawing actionable insights to support decision-making processes.

Communication Skills : Ability to effectively communicate technical information and insights to various stakeholders across different levels of the organization.

Project Management : Capability to juggle multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks, and adhere to timelines while ensuring quality deliverables.

Collaboration : Aptitude for collaborating with cross-functional teams, including Product Management, User Experience, Technology, Marketing, and Customer Insights, to achieve common objectives.

Problem-Solving : Capacity to think creatively, strategically, and technically to address challenges and identify opportunities for site enhancement and monetization.

Ownership : Desire and ability to take ownership of products/projects, driving them from conception to execution while ensuring alignment with business objectives.

Technical Proficiency : Familiarity with digital analytics tools and MS Office programs to effectively analyze data, generate reports, and develop dashboards for internal stakeholders, including proficiency with SQL queries.

Continuous Learning : Willingness to stay updated on emerging trends and best practices in digital analytics and e-commerce to enhance skills and knowledge in the field.

Adaptability : Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs in a dynamic environment.

Who You Are

- Candidates with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply. 1-2 years of direct experience.

- Must demonstrate proficiency in writing and troubleshooting SQL/GBQ queries.

- This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.

- Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Job Overview

Lead Analyst, Product Analytics ensures the organization can measure and understand the impact of new digital features across the customer experience. This role connects analyses across product domains, designs and evaluates experiments, and transforms complex data into clear recommendations and compelling stories. The Lead Analyst also leads team of analysts in their day-to-day work, champions analytics best practices, and raises awareness of team opportunities, blockers, and accomplishments to enable timely, high-quality results.

What You Will Do

-
Provide analytics thought leadership to digital and enterprise partners to improve site functionality, feature development, and omni-channel analytics.

-
Lead strategic analytics initiatives across teams and product domain.

-
Solve complex analytical problems to identify opportunities that improve the customer experience.

-
Lead analysts by directly overseeing work, supporting day-to-day analyses, and raising awareness of opportunities, blockers, and accomplishments.

-
Develop standard reporting, analytical frameworks, and key performance indicators that enable critical business decisions.

-
Identify opportunities to automate and enhance existing reporting and analytical processes.

-
Define and execute audits of analytics tracking to ensure accurate data collection across analytics systems.

-
Develop training and promote best practices that help product teams and analysts use data and tools effectively.

-
Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities.

-
In addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned.

Skills You Will Need

-
Product Analytics:  Advanced ability to analyze digital feature performance, site usage, and customer experience across product domains.

-

-
Experimentation: Ability to design, implement, and evaluate experiments that generate actionable business insights.

-
Data Storytelling:  Ability to translate complex findings into clear recommendations, reports, visualizations, and compelling narratives.

-
Analytics Leadership:  Ability to lead analysts, lead cross-functional initiatives, deliver training, and influence digital and enterprise partners.

Who You Are

-
8+ plus years of experience in e-commerce and/or retail analytics

-
Bachelor’s degree required, with a Master’s degree in Statistics, Analytics, Mathematics, or a related field preferred.

Proven track record of applying analytics expertise to complex customer and business problems and influencing cross-functional partners through data-driven recommendations.

-
Advanced proficiency with web analytics tools, preferably Adobe Analytics

-
Strong expertise in SQL and data manipulation, with experience using Tableau or other visualization platforms.
